ManusAPIKeyCredential.title: Manus API Key
ManusAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In Manus Developers settings, create an API key and paste it here. The key grants full access to your Manus account. NoClick sends it in x-manus-api-key and checks the account with the read-only user.me endpoint.

ManusCreateProjectConfig.description: Creates a new project. Projects let you group related tasks and apply shared instructions. Pass the returned ID as `project_id` in [task.create](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.create) to create tasks within this project.

instruction.description: Default instruction that will be automatically prepended to all tasks created within this project. Use this to enforce consistent behavior across related tasks (e.g., "Always respond in formal English" or "Focus on financial analysis").
instruction.title: Instruction

ManusCreateProjectConfig.title: ManusCreateProjectConfig

ManusCreateTaskConfig.description: Creates a new task. The task runs asynchronously. Poll for progress with [task.listMessages](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.listMessages), send follow-ups with [task.sendMessage](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.sendMessage).

message.description: The message to start the task with. Contains the prompt text, optional file attachments, and connector/skill configuration.

website.description: Optional. An existing website for the new task to edit — the same as attaching the website in the Manus app. `message.content` must also contain a non-empty text instruction; a `hidden` text part also counts. Only web websites owned by the authorized user are accepted; mobile apps and games are not. Only task.create has this field: follow-up messages through [task.sendMessage](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.sendMessage) only need the instruction.

project_id.description: Project ID to associate this task with. The project's instruction will be automatically applied. Use [project.list](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/project.list) to get available project IDs.
project_id.title: Project Id

locale.description: Locale for the task output language (e.g., "en", "zh-CN", "ja"). Defaults to the user's account locale setting.
locale.title: Locale

interactive_mode.description: When enabled, the agent may pause and ask follow-up questions if the input is insufficient. When disabled (default), the agent proceeds with best-effort execution without asking.
interactive_mode.title: Interactive Mode

hide_in_task_list.description: When true, the task does not appear in the Manus webapp task list. It remains accessible through the `task_url` in the response.
hide_in_task_list.title: Hide In Task List

agent_profile.description: Agent profile to use for the task. Use the stable values `standard` (default), `lite`, or `max`. For `max`, you can also choose a thinking level with `max-medium`, `max-high`, `max-extra`, or `max-ultra` (deepest reasoning, slowest, and highest credit usage); plain `max` uses the default Max thinking level, currently equivalent to `max-extra`. Versioned aliases such as `1.6-lite`, `2.0-max`, `2.0-max-ultra`, and the legacy `manus-1.6-lite` form are also accepted; the version segment is ignored because model versions are not selected independently. A version without a suffix, such as `1.6` or `manus-1.6`, means `standard`. Omit the field (or pass an empty string) to use `standard`. Free personal accounts are downgraded to `lite` regardless of the requested value.
agent_profile.title: Agent Profile

title.description: Custom title for the task. If not provided, a title is generated from the input message. If generation times out, `task_title` is the placeholder `generating title...`; fetch `task.detail` later for the updated title.
title.title: Title

async_title.description: When `true` and `title` is omitted, the task is created without waiting for title generation. `task_title` is the placeholder `generating title...` until the title is ready; fetch `task.detail` later for the updated title. Ignored when `title` is provided.
async_title.title: Async Title

structured_output_schema.description: JSON Schema for structured output extraction. When provided, the agent runs normally, then a post-processing step extracts a result conforming to your schema. The schema must follow the [Structured Output](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/structured-output) subset of JSON Schema: all object properties must be listed in `required`, and `additionalProperties` must be `false`.
structured_output_schema.title: Structured Output Schema

clear_connectors.description: Clears the connector selection for the new task. The task starts without connectors; the project's default connectors and your default connectors are not loaded. Cannot be combined with a non-empty `message.connectors`. Other task features may still provide tools.
clear_connectors.title: Clear Connectors

ManusCreateTaskConfig.title: ManusCreateTaskConfig

ManusCreateWebhookConfig.description: Creates a webhook for receiving task event notifications. Use [webhook.publicKey](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/webhook.publicKey) to get the key for verifying signatures.

url.description: The HTTPS endpoint URL that will receive POST webhook notifications. Must be publicly accessible and return a 2xx status code.
url.title: Url

ManusCreateWebhookConfig.title: ManusCreateWebhookConfig

ManusDeleteFileConfig.description: Deletes a file. Files are automatically deleted 48 hours after upload, so manual deletion is only needed for early cleanup.

file_id.description: The unique identifier of the file to delete.
file_id.title: File Id

ManusDeleteFileConfig.title: ManusDeleteFileConfig

ManusDeleteTaskConfig.description: Deletes a task permanently. If the task is still running, use [task.stop](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.stop) first.

task_id.description: The unique identifier of the task to delete. Agent-related tasks cannot be deleted.
task_id.title: Task Id

ManusDeleteTaskConfig.title: ManusDeleteTaskConfig

ManusDeleteWebhookConfig.description: Deletes a webhook. The endpoint will stop receiving notifications immediately. Use [webhook.list](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/webhook.list) to find the webhook ID.

webhook_id.description: The unique identifier of the webhook to delete.
webhook_id.title: Webhook Id

ManusDeleteWebhookConfig.title: ManusDeleteWebhookConfig

ManusGetAvailableCreditsConfig.description: Returns the credit balance, subscription period, and refresh information for the authenticated caller. For a team sub-account, the team's shared pool balance is returned; for a personal account, the personal balance is returned. Standard OAuth clients cannot access this endpoint; trusted clients can.
ManusGetAvailableCreditsConfig.title: ManusGetAvailableCreditsConfig

ManusGetCurrentUserConfig.description: Returns the Manus user ID associated with the authenticated API key or OAuth2 access token. API Key and Trusted client callers also receive the user's display name, email, and avatar. This endpoint is read-only and does not require an OAuth scope.
ManusGetCurrentUserConfig.title: ManusGetCurrentUserConfig

ManusGetFileConfig.description: Retrieves a file's details including upload status, size, and expiration time. For an uploaded, unexpired file, also returns a temporary GET download URL and its expiration time at the top level of the response. Use this to download an uploaded attachment for validation before creating a task. Check that `file.status` is `uploaded` before using the file in [task.create](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.create). Files expire 48 hours after upload.

file_id.description: The unique identifier of the file to retrieve.
file_id.title: File Id

ManusGetFileConfig.title: ManusGetFileConfig

ManusGetProjectConfig.description: Retrieves a project's full configuration: name, instruction, default connectors, and default skills. [project.list](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/project.list) returns only each project's ID, name, and creation time; call this endpoint before [project.update](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/project.update) to read the current values.

project_id.description: The unique identifier of the project to retrieve. Use [project.list](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/project.list) to get project IDs.
project_id.title: Project Id

ManusGetProjectConfig.title: ManusGetProjectConfig

ManusGetSkillConfig.description: Retrieves one skill's details and a temporary download URL for its current archive.
ManusGetSkillConfig.title: ManusGetSkillConfig

ManusGetTaskConfig.description: Retrieves a task's status and metadata. Use [task.listMessages](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.listMessages) for the full event history, or [task.sendMessage](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.sendMessage) to continue the conversation.

task_id.description: The unique identifier of the task to retrieve. Supports the shortcut `agent-default-main_task` for the IM agent's main task.
task_id.title: Task Id

ManusGetTaskConfig.title: ManusGetTaskConfig

ManusListArtifactsConfig.description: Lists generated task artifacts from the authenticated user's Manus Library, newest first. Temporary input files from file.upload are not included.

limit.description: Maximum artifacts per page. Default 20, maximum 100. A page can be short or empty while `has_more` is true.
limit.title: Limit

cursor.description: Opaque `next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

name.description: Search the artifact display name. Results stay ordered by creation time.
name.title: Name

type.description: Filter by Library category. Default `all`. The ten specific categories are mutually exclusive.
type.title: Type

favorite.description: When `true`, return only favorited artifacts. Omitted or `false` applies no favorite filter.
favorite.title: Favorite

oauth_client_id.description: Return only artifacts from tasks created by this Open App. Mutually exclusive with `api_key_id`; passing both returns `400 invalid_argument`.
oauth_client_id.title: Oauth Client Id

api_key_id.description: Return only artifacts from tasks created by this API key. Mutually exclusive with `oauth_client_id`; passing both returns `400 invalid_argument`.
api_key_id.title: Api Key Id

ManusListArtifactsConfig.title: ManusListArtifactsConfig

ManusListConnectorsConfig.description: Lists connectors installed in the current user's account. Use the returned IDs in the `connectors` array of [task.create](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.create) or [task.sendMessage](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.sendMessage).
ManusListConnectorsConfig.title: ManusListConnectorsConfig

ManusListMessagesConfig.description: Lists event messages for a task with cursor-based pagination. Use this to poll for progress after [task.create](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.create) or [task.sendMessage](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.sendMessage).

task_id.description: The unique identifier of the task to list messages for. Supports the shortcut `agent-default-main_task` for the IM agent's main task.
task_id.title: Task Id

limit.description: Number of messages to return per page. Default: 50, Range: 1-200.
limit.title: Limit

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's next_cursor field. Omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

start_event_id.description: Start at this event, inclusive. Use a value from `messages[].id`. Cannot be combined with `cursor`. The response may still include `next_cursor` for following pages. If the ID appears only in `verbose=true` responses, use `verbose=true` or the event is not found.
start_event_id.title: Start Event Id

slides_format.description: Format of slides attachments in the response.
slides_format.title: Slides Format

markdown_format.description: Format of Markdown attachments in `assistant_message.attachments`. An attachment is treated as Markdown when its filename ends in `.md` or `.markdown`, or its `content_type` contains `markdown`.
markdown_format.title: Markdown Format

ManusListMessagesConfig.title: ManusListMessagesConfig

ManusListProjectsConfig.description: Lists all projects. Use the returned IDs as `project_id` in [task.create](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.create) or [task.list](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.list).
ManusListProjectsConfig.title: ManusListProjectsConfig

ManusListSkillsConfig.description: Lists installed skills available for task selection.

project_id.description: Only API Keys and trusted OAuth clients can pass `project_id`; when provided, the response also includes project skills. Standard OAuth clients that pass this parameter receive InvalidArgument (HTTP 400). Use [project.list](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/project.list) to get available project IDs.
project_id.title: Project Id

ManusListSkillsConfig.title: ManusListSkillsConfig

ManusListTasksConfig.description: Lists tasks with optional filtering and cursor-based pagination. Use `scope` to filter by task type, e.g. `agent_subtask` with `agent_id` for agent subtasks.

limit.description: Number of tasks to return per page. Default: 20, Max: 100.
limit.title: Limit

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's next_cursor field. Omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

order.description: Sort direction by creation time. "desc" (default) returns newest first, "asc" returns oldest first.
order.title: Order

agent_id.description: Filter tasks by agent. Required when scope="agent_subtask". Supports the shortcut `agent-default` for the IM agent. Use [agent.list](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/agent.list) to get available agent IDs.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

project_id.description: Filter tasks by project. Required when scope="project". Use [project.list](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/project.list) to get available project IDs.
project_id.title: Project Id

oauth_client_id.description: Return only tasks created by this Open App. Mutually exclusive with `api_key_id`; passing both returns `invalid_argument`. Unknown IDs return an empty list.
oauth_client_id.title: Oauth Client Id

api_key_id.description: Return only tasks created by this API key. Mutually exclusive with `oauth_client_id`; passing both returns `invalid_argument`. Unknown IDs return an empty list.
api_key_id.title: Api Key Id

include_deleted.description: Include deleted tasks in the results. Default: `false`.
include_deleted.title: Include Deleted

ManusListTasksConfig.title: ManusListTasksConfig

ManusListWebhooksConfig.description: Lists all webhooks in your account. Use the returned IDs with [webhook.delete](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/webhook.delete) to remove a webhook.
ManusListWebhooksConfig.title: ManusListWebhooksConfig

ManusMessage.description: Plain text messages with optional connector and skill selections.

content.description: Prompt text, limited by Manus to approximately 5,000 estimated tokens.
content.title: Content

ManusMessage.title: ManusMessage

ManusSendMessageConfig.description: Sends a follow-up message to a task for multi-turn conversation. Use this after [task.create](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.create) to continue talking, or to answer `messageAskUser` / `cascadeAskUser` questions with ordinary message.content. For supported action confirmations, review confirm_input_schema and the target tool event, then use [task.confirmAction](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.confirmAction). Do not automatically confirm unrecognized waiting types.

task_id.description: The unique identifier of the task to send the message to. Supports the shortcut `agent-default-main_task` for the IM agent's main task.
task_id.title: Task Id

message.description: The follow-up message. Supports the same content formats as task.create (plain text or multi-part with files). A non-empty `message.connectors` replaces the task's connector selection; omitting it or passing an empty array keeps the task's current selection. To clear the selection, use the top-level `clear_connectors` field.

agent_profile.description: Agent profile override for this turn and subsequent turns. Use the stable values `standard`, `lite`, or `max`, or a Max thinking level: `max-medium`, `max-high`, `max-extra`, or `max-ultra`. The thinking level also applies to subsequent turns; plain `max` keeps the level the task already uses; a task that has never selected a level uses the default, currently equivalent to `max-extra`. Versioned aliases such as `1.6-lite`, `2.0-max`, `2.0-max-ultra`, and the legacy `manus-1.6-lite` form are also accepted; the version segment is ignored because model versions are not selected independently. A version without a suffix, such as `1.6` or `manus-1.6`, means `standard`. Omit the field (or pass an empty string) to keep the task's current profile and thinking level; unlike [task.create](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.create), this endpoint does not default to `standard`. Free personal accounts are downgraded to `lite` when an override is provided.
agent_profile.title: Agent Profile

structured_output_schema.description: JSON Schema for structured output extraction, armed for the next time this task finishes (`stop_reason: finish`).
structured_output_schema.title: Structured Output Schema

clear_connectors.description: Clears the task's connector selection for this and subsequent turns. Cannot be combined with a non-empty `message.connectors`. Other task features may still provide tools.
clear_connectors.title: Clear Connectors

ManusSendMessageConfig.title: ManusSendMessageConfig

ManusStopTaskConfig.description: Stops a running task. The task status will change to `stopped`. A stopped task can still be resumed with [task.sendMessage](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.sendMessage).

task_id.description: The unique identifier of the running task to stop. Supports the shortcut `agent-default-main_task` for the IM agent's main task.
task_id.title: Task Id

ManusStopTaskConfig.title: ManusStopTaskConfig

ManusUpdateProjectConfig.description: Updates a project's name, instruction, default connectors, or default skills. Omitted fields are unchanged; a request with no updatable field returns `400 invalid_argument`. `connector_ids` and `skill_ids` replace the entire list. Returns the full updated configuration in the same shape as [project.detail](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/project.detail).

project_id.description: The unique identifier of the project to update. Use [project.list](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/project.list) to get project IDs.
project_id.title: Project Id

name.description: New display name, 1–255 characters. Cannot be empty or whitespace only.
name.title: Name

clear_instruction.description: Clear the project's default instruction. Takes precedence over Instruction.
clear_instruction.title: Clear Instruction

instruction.description: New default instruction applied to tasks in this project, up to 65,535 UTF-8 bytes. Use Clear instruction to remove it; leave this blank to keep it unchanged.
instruction.title: Instruction

connector_ids.description: Replaces the project's default connectors with this list. Pass `[]` to remove all default connectors; omit the field to keep them unchanged. Accepts up to 500 connector IDs from [connector.list](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/connector.list); duplicates are ignored. Each connector must be installed and authorized in the user's account. A Standard OAuth client can set only connectors the user granted to the app, and the My Browser connector also requires the `use_my_browsers` scope.
connector_ids.title: Connector Ids

skill_ids.description: Replaces the project's default skills with this list. Pass `[]` to remove all default skills; omit the field to keep them unchanged. Accepts up to 50 skill IDs from [skill.list](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/skill.list); duplicates are ignored. Each skill must be an official skill, a Skill Hub skill, a skill of the user's team, or a skill of this project; other skills, including personal and Open App skills, return `404 not_found`. Project members' individual skill preferences are kept.
skill_ids.title: Skill Ids

ManusUpdateProjectConfig.title: ManusUpdateProjectConfig

ManusUpdateTaskConfig.description: Updates a task's metadata (title, sharing, visibility). Use [task.detail](https://open.manus.ai/docs/v2/task.detail) to see the current values before updating.

task_id.description: The unique identifier of the task to update. Supports the shortcut `agent-default-main_task` for the IM agent's main task.
task_id.title: Task Id

title.description: New title for the task. Replaces the auto-generated title.
title.title: Title

share_visibility.description: Controls who can view the task. "private" — only the task creator can view. "team" — all team members can view. "public" — anyone with the share_url can view.
share_visibility.title: Share Visibility

enable_visible_in_task_list.description: When true, the task appears in the Manus webapp task list. When false, hides the task from the list (still accessible via direct URL).
enable_visible_in_task_list.title: Enable Visible In Task List

ManusUpdateTaskConfig.title: ManusUpdateTaskConfig

id.description: Existing web website ID owned by this Manus account.
id.title: Id

credentials.description: Credentials for this node (optional if using environment variables)
